title: Java and JavaScript

content.explanation: Java and JavaScript are different technologies with different goals. Java focused on larger applications and portability through the JVM. JavaScript focused on lightweight browser scripting and direct page interaction. Although they coexisted for years, JavaScript eventually became the primary browser language.
content.example: Java applets handled larger isolated tasks while JavaScript managed page events.
content.analogy: A truck and a bicycle both transport things but serve different purposes.
content.keyTakeaway: Java and JavaScript solve different problems.

revisionSummary: Java and JavaScript are different technologies.

mcqs.question: Which technology directly manipulates webpage elements?
A developer needs quick page interaction. Which fits best?
JavaScript is simply a version of Java.
